Unified 16GB Memory Equipped with 16GB unified memory, this 13.6-inch laptop enables efficient data sharing between the CPU and GPU within a single architecture. Full HD Recording Support Supporting 1080p HD video recording along with Desk View functionality, this Apple laptop enhances presentation flexibility during calls. Durable IP65 Splash Protection Incorporating IP65-rated splash resistance, this Android smartphone offers protection against light water exposure. Thus, this feature supports durability during daily handling and usage in varied environments.
